audience_question: 予約サイトのどの操作と分岐を変え、何を測るか？
reading_context: Community workshop booking design proposal, read without a presenter. Japanese adult audience.
dominant_message: 空席を最初に伝え、予約前の判断材料を一画面に集める。

information_structure.description: 空席を最初に伝え、予約前の判断材料を一画面に集める。

required_content: 見出し「分岐は、空席で決まる。」
左側は「開催日」から「空席？」へ、空席ありなら「予約入力」、満席なら「次の日程」へ分岐
分岐ラベルは「空席あり」「満席」
右側は予約画面のwireframe、文字は「地域ワークショップ」「会場」「所要時間」「持ち物」「この日程で予約」
資格注記「仮想サイトの設計案。数値は目標値、実測ではありません。」
semantic_relationships: Seat availability controls one of two alternative paths. The right wireframe shows information visible before reservation.
evidence: Original fictional booking concept written for this example; no observed analytics.
assumptions: All counts and percentages are targets, not measurements.
open_questions: Actual booking abandonment and user preference to be measured after implementation.
avoid: No logo, no photograph, no false measured-result claim, no card grids.
visual_obligations: Left half uses a true branch diagram, straight flat rectangles and one diamond, arrows clearly point to alternatives. Right half contains only one large plain rectangular screen, a heading, three aligned information lines, and one blue wide action button. Use cobalt for available path and orange for full path.
explicit_user_visual_requirements: Landscape wide slide 1600 × 900, all substantive content safely inside 80px margin. No header/footer/page numbers.
Japanese text exactly as specified; clean heavy Japanese gothic headings resembling Dela, BIZ body. English/Arabic numbers clean geometric sans like Manrope.
Flat ivory background #F7F5EE, ink #112132, vivid cobalt #2B74EE and vermilion #E34F2D. Raster design will be reconstructed with native PowerPoint objects, so only simple flat shapes.
